description: QuantaStor Crypto Library (QSCL) is used by the core services within the Linux based QuantaStor Software-Defined Storage Platform. QSCL links with a FIPS enabled version of OpenSSL library and it provides functionality to handle all key generation and encryption services used by QuantaStor platform.
